lineup.boostLimits: tournament-specific limit on the rarity/boost mix
lineup.scoreFormula: Lineup Score = sum(Creator Motion Score * card Score Boost)
lineup.boostCapNote: the docs say a lineup must meet limits on Score Boosts, but never state a number or how boosts are combined (sum, cap per tier, ranking). The tier multipliers themselves are published; the limit is not. Unmodelled on purpose.
lineup.projectedScoreField: projected is rank-relative to the best-available lineup on this board, not the game's Lineup Score

stars.basis: performance relative to other creators over the past 14 days
stars.pointsContribution: none - stars only gate eligibility via the star cap
stars.dropRateEffect: more stars = lower chance in a Starter Pack

rarity.function: sets the Score Boost multiplier applied to that creator's Motion Score
rarity.boostValuesNote: published in docs.motion.game/docs/get-cards/understanding-cards (read 2026-11-15): Common 1x, Rare 1.5x, Epic 2x, Legendary 2.5x. The per-tournament boost limit and how boosts combine are NOT stated.
rarity.dropRates: printed in the Pack Shop in-game; the docs page shows them redacted
rarity.sameCreator: two cards of one creator can differ in rarity; same creator, same star rating, different boost

motionScore.basis: X, Instagram, TikTok and YouTube engagement during the tournament
motionScore.crossPlatform: signals normalised and compared against the creator pool

cardFields: SRC (how many of the 4 platforms active)
